title: Erbil Arrival & Newroz at Akre
full_text:
Arrival in the morning to Erbil Night (1), transfer to hotel.
Late start in the day, exploring the bazaar of the citadel.
Visit the citadel and the surrounding buzzling markets.
Start heading to Akre by 2 PM.
Attending the ceremony of Newroz from the Akre mountain, with an option to stay in a cafe at the beginning of the hike.
Head Back to Erbil.
